## Endpoints

### Auth Flow (1)
- `GET /api/a11y-data/v0/page/{pageToken}/DESKTOP/WIDGET_ON/status` — Check accessibility status for a specific page token.

### Data Read (4)
- `GET /api/br-links/v0/contribute/{contributeId}` — Retrieve contribution data by its ID.
- `GET /api/br-links/v0/links/{linkId}` — Retrieve a specific BR link by its ID.
- `GET /pagead/conversion/{conversionTimestamp}/` — Get conversion data for a specific timestamp.
- `GET /widgetapp/{widgetappDate}/locales/en-US.json` — Retrieve locale data for a specific widget app.

### Data Write (1)
- `POST /api/v1/tunings/Zg78mkkmfb` — Update tuning data with a specific ID.

### Search (1)
- `GET /api/stories-search` — Search for career stories based on criteria.

### Config (1)
- `GET /web-interactives/public/v1/embed/combinedConfigs` — Get combined configuration settings for web interactives.
